invite.help: The tenant needs an account to sign in. Share on WhatsApp makes a one-time link you send from your own WhatsApp. Send email sends a welcome email with the same kind of one-time link to set a password.

invite.shareText:
Hi {{name}}, your tenant account is ready. Set your password here: {{link}}
The link works once and expires on {{date}}. Please do not share it.

invite.welcome: Hi {{name}}, {{org}} has set up your tenant account.
invite.signInWith: You will sign in with {{email}}. This link expires on {{date}}.
invite.done: Your password is set. Sign in with {{email}} and your new password.
invite.gone: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask your landlord or administrator for a new one.
invite.demoWhatsapp: Demo mode: WhatsApp is not connected, so nothing was delivered (the message is only recorded in the test outbox). Use Share on WhatsApp to send the link from your own phone.
invite.helpWithSend: The tenant needs an account to sign in. Share on WhatsApp makes a one-time link you send from your own WhatsApp. Send by WhatsApp has the app send it (needs the tenant's WhatsApp consent). Send email sends a welcome email with the same kind of one-time link to set a password.
invite.shareTextBrand:
Hi {{name}}, your tenant account with {{brand}} is ready. Set your password here: {{link}}
The link works once and expires on {{date}}. Please do not share it.
invite.welcomeStaff: Hi {{name}}, {{org}} has set up your staff account.
